_comment: Public0.2.4 composed from accepted backend and runtime sources; independent public version map recorded privately.

notes.en: Moves durable session, communication and usage state to SQLite-backed stores. Retain an offline backup; automatic rollback across this migration is unavailable.
notes.zh-CN: 会话、通信及用量的持久状态迁入 SQLite。请保留离线备份；无法跨过本次迁移自动回退。

notes.en: Adds persisted worker service records that older cutex versions cannot read. Keep a backup and do not downgrade a store containing worker services to an older release.
notes.zh-CN: 新增旧版 cutex 无法读取的 worker 服务持久记录。请保留备份，不要把包含后台应用记录的数据退回旧版。

notes.en: Reliable queued-input disposal, bounded file reads, alarm wake timing, Native0.167.0-r61 and Claude claude-r48. On a manual return to 0.2.3, dismissals still waiting to apply are not applied there; dismiss those rows again in that version. The records are retained and used again after returning to 0.2.4.
notes.zh-CN: 改进排队输入处置、分段文件读取与闹钟唤醒时机，提供 Native0.167.0-r61 和 Claude claude-r48。 若手动退回 0.2.3，当时尚未执行完的放弃操作不会由旧版执行，请在旧版重新放弃相应行。记录仍会保留，回到 0.2.4 后继续使用。
